subject: Ephemeral capacity credits and prorate clarity
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia@brightline.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightline.com
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — short-term credits for campaign launch

Alex —

We have a last-minute shift in our launch plan for the new Brightline Ads product and expect a 48-hour spike the week of Aug 6. Our engineering team confirmed they can throttle client-side but we still need short-term headroom to avoid rate limiting during the ad push.

Can Redwood provide a temporary capacity credit or a short-term quota bump (48–72 hours)? If possible: 1) credit for the overrun instead of rolling over to next month, and 2) a clear statement of how the overage will appear on the invoice (line item vs. blended). Procurement is on copy — they will need PO language if we move forward.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ramos
Head of Integrations, Brightline Media
sofia@brightline.com

--
Attachment: launch-plan-summary.pdf (stub)

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia@brightline.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — short-term credits for campaign launch

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the heads up and congrats on the push. Short version: yes, we can offer a short-window headroom package and two invoice options. Details below.

Proposal (48–72 hrs):
- Ephemeral capacity credit: pre-authorized buffer equivalent to 150% of your committed QPS for the 72-hour window.
- Billing: two options — (A) Overrun credited as a one-time invoice credit applied after month-end reconciliation, or (B) Separate overrun line item billed at the overage rate with an immediate credit applied (net effect similar but different line-item visibility).
- Rate: overrun billed at 0.9x of published PAYG token rate (reflects a short-window partner discount) if Brightline signs the attached short-window addendum.

I attached a one-page headroom rate sheet with exact numbers and a redlineable addendum. If procurement is comfortable with the PO language, we can provision the buffer once we have a signed addendum and PO.

Cc'ing Ben and Marissa for FYI — Ben, can we do 0.9x for this specific product-level overrun, and can finance accept the credit flow described?

— Alex
Alex Martinez
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.com

--
Attachment: Brightline_Headroom_Rate_Sheet_v3.pdf (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia@brightline.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Jul 2028 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — short-term credits for campaign launch

Alex / Sofia —

0.9x PAYG for a 72-hour window is acceptable as a one-off. A couple of constraints from finance:
1) Total cap on discounted overrun credits should not exceed $40k for the event (we can go higher but need a revenue-side approval).
2) Credits applied post-month-end require a signed addendum plus a PO referencing the addendum id.
3) If Brightline prefers the overrun to appear as a separate line item (option B), finance will need the final invoice example (we can provide a mock).

Marissa — can you draft the addendum and PO language today so we can expedite?

Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

--
(Internal note: ensure legal reviews the addendum template for future reuse)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia@brightline.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Jul 2028 15:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Short-window addendum and PO language

Sofia —

Attached is the short-window addendum (v1) and a PO sample that procurement can use. Key bits:
- Effective window tied to the calendar timestamps in the PO.
- Discounted overrun capped at $40,000 per event unless pre-approved by sales leadership.
- Billing: we default to option A (post-month reconciliation credit) unless procurement checks the separate-line preference.

If procurement confirms the PO number and signs the addendum, we will trigger provisioning (and send a DocuSign link for signature).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Contracts Manager — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
